name: AI Coding Workstation (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI)
description: Browser VS Code and terminal with AI coding CLIs and a persistent home.

PASSWORD.description: Login password for the browser IDE (code-server). Generated at deploy; copy it from this variable. Minimum 12 characters.

PORT.description: Port code-server listens on; the public domain targets it.

SSH_PASSWORD.description: Password for SSH as user 'coder' through the TCP proxy. Clear it to allow key-only SSH; with no password and no keys, sshd is not started.

SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS.description: Optional SSH public keys (one per line) allowed to log in as 'coder'. Keys you add to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys also persist.

SSH_PORT.description: Port sshd listens on inside the container; the TCP proxy targets it.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Claude Code uses it instead of a Claude.ai login. Leave empty to log in with your Pro/Max subscription.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Codex CLI uses it instead of a ChatGPT login (codex login --device-auth).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Gemini CLI uses it instead of a Google login.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets OpenCode use OpenRouter models.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional GitHub token for gh and HTTPS git (configured as git credential helper at start).

GIT_REPO.description: Optional repository URL cloned once into ~/workspace on first start (private repos need GITHUB_TOKEN).

WORKSTATION_ENV_PASSTHROUGH.description: Optional comma-separated names of extra variables to expose in SSH sessions (the browser terminal sees all variables).

TZ.description: Time zone for shells and tools (e.g. Europe/Istanbul).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period for code-server and running CLIs to exit cleanly on redeploy.
